summary: The current linked task-43 driver still enters stock’s 37 machine tables; the dispatcher, machine-0 router and task loop have owned entry veneers. The nested candidate-module boundaries below are separately required reference-only obligations: host providers and owned internal calls do not establish complete-image execution, caller closure or retirement. The clean controllers crate's Root port requires Lens3c's completion fields in the Root record for status notification `0xf46f28`, followed by current Root-context release. Ordinary Started completions use the Live record instead. Command24 has no deferred-option root binding: it forwards the original event to Live. The obsolete root `LiveSequence`, `RefreshDeferred` and `SetDeferredOption` variants are removed. The production composition owner binds these ports and qualifies ordered boundary scenarios in the linked image before retiring the corresponding stock actions. S1's explicit zero definitions and retained-reader limits are recorded in [the boundary documentation](README.md#saclac).
